svg.text: Buses from Beaconsfield to nearby places

Find where you want to go, around the edge of the diagram.
Follow its coloured line in to Beaconsfield at the centre.
The badge on that line is the bus service number.

Confirm live times & fares at bustimes.org or operator apps. Journey times shown are approximate. Diagram — not to scale.
